answer: Split the ledger archive into erasure-coded pieces and give every identity one piece no other identity holds. Each week it must rebuild its piece from neighbours' fragments and prove the rebuild matches the public hash: one mends a delta block where the river met the ocean, another a crystal-timestamped receipt. A farm running a thousand clones must store and rebuild a thousand distinct pieces; sharing one script saves nothing, and a missing piece is a hole anyone can point to, tied to exactly one name.
